{{Top}}
[[File:IronAsteroidCorellia.jpg|170px|thumb|An iron asteroid located in the Corellia system]]
{{Quote|But the battle droids are ''non-magnetic''!''"<br />"''Yes&hellip; But lava contains ''iron''&mdash;and the volcano doused your droids with it!|Reynar and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="da">{{TCWComicCite|6.51|Deadly Allies}}</ref>}}
'''Iron''' was an element commonly found in [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and, occasionally, on [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It could be extracted from the iron ore minerals [[Magnetite/Legends|magnetite]] and [[hematite]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] was said to have significant deposits of iron.<ref name="DF:JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] also had deposits of especially strong [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]].

Iron was used in the making of many objects. It was used with [[Concrete/Legends|concrete]] to make [[Ferrocrete/Legends|Ferrocrete]]. [[Pummelstave]]s were constructed from tubes of iron. The city of [[Thousand Thousand]] on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] had structures composed of iron, which survived several wars with little exterior damage.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The door to the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was made of iron.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novel]]</ref>
